breaking.change: A screen is on the stack once: pushing a screen that is already on the stack is refused with an error, where it stacked a second copy.
breaking.fix: Pop the screen before pushing it again, or use og.ui.replace.

breaking.change: A list a pushed screen iterates with {#each} has rows that each carry a unique nonempty string id, the key the each names ((row.id)). A screen iterating any other list reports "each over '$rows' needs a keyed list; give each of its rows a unique string id" and is not drawn. A list the screen only reads whole is unaffected.
breaking.fix: Give each row of an iterated list a unique string id and key the each by it.

breaking.change: A document whose root is a block ({#if}, {#each}) is refused with "a document's root is one element; put the block inside it".
breaking.fix: Wrap the block in one root element.

added.summary: og.ui.screenVm(screen) returns the screen's values as they are now: what was pushed, with what the screen's controls wrote through bind:. It is null once the screen has left the stack.

fixed.summary: A pushed screen is built the way a mounted document is, so it resolves only the elements whose values changed and keeps its elements' state across frames. A dropdown or tooltip a layer opens is ordered just above that layer.
